quoting_basis.compare_note: How deals of different lengths are ranked: 'horizon' costs every deal over term_months (a longer PCP settled early, a shorter one's balloon paid and the car kept, a lease over its own term); 'own' ranks each deal over its own term.
quoting_basis.residual_note: Expected market value at 36 months as a share of list price, for the true-monthly comparison. An assumption until a used-market source replaces it: UK EV residuals at three years sit around 40-50% and lenders' GFVs a little under. The GFV is the floor, this is the expectation.
quoting_basis.savings_note: Easy-access savings rate used to discount every cash flow: money not spent on a car earns this.
